slug: 2026-02-10 Algeria launches national public-data governance framework (Decree 25-350)

facts.fact: Prime Minister Sifi Ghrieb launched Algeria's national data-governance framework on 9 February 2026, a legal, institutional and technical framework for collecting, storing, sharing and using public data, anchored in Presidential Decree No. 25-350 of 30 December 2025 as this source numbers it.
